acceptance_criteria: Changes that affect generated build output are detected by the long-lived service and reflected without requiring an unrelated file edit to force reload.
description: Ensure WorkspaceService invalidates or reloads when build-generated OUT_DIR semantics can change instead of serving stale generated symbols until some unrelated tracked file changes.

notes.author: darin@book
notes.content: Audit: verified in /Users/darin/Projects/raql on jj change df9c29baa0d3. Added explicit auxiliary build-input watch state for build-script workspaces so non-Rust inputs like schema files force reload and refresh generated OUT_DIR symbols. Verification: cargo test -p raql-host-ra && cargo test --test cli_daemon_cutover -- --nocapture && cargo test --test cli_strict_runtime -- --nocapture.

title: Track generated build output refresh in the long-lived service
